text: 比如说，研究中国历史，无论哪个时期，都一定要参考外国史料，外国人的游记，回忆录等等，才能得到正确信息。
en: For example, when studying Chinese history, no matter which period, you must consult foreign historical materials, foreigners' travel notes, memoirs and so on, in order to obtain correct information.

text: 如果你只看官史，正史，那就是活在信息茧房里。
en: If you only read official histories and orthodox histories, you are living in an information cocoon.

text: 谢邀。
en: Thanks for the invitation.

text: 首先意识到自己在信息茧房中，是一件好事，我曾陷入信息茧房一段时间，那时候觉得整个人都魔怔了，感觉没有了自己的主见。
en: First realising that you are in an information cocoon is a good thing. I was once trapped in an information cocoon for a while; at that time I felt the whole person had become obsessed, feeling I had lost my own opinions.

text: 摆脱信息茧房，第一件要做的事情就是不看推荐内容。
en: The first thing to do to escape the information cocoon is to stop watching recommended content.

text: 包括知乎的推荐，B站的首页推荐，以及其他有算法推荐的内容。
en: Including Zhihu recommendations, Bilibili homepage recommendations, and other algorithm-recommended content.

text: 如果觉得知乎的热榜不够看，就关注一些优秀回答者：
en: If you find Zhihu's hot list insufficient, follow some excellent answerers:

text: 第二件事，就是找到自己兴趣的方向，这个方向的问题是可以给你带来正向情绪的，而不是越看越难受的。
en: The second thing is to find a direction of interest for yourself — a direction whose questions can bring you positive emotions, rather than making you feel worse the more you read.

text: 多搜索这样的内容，在有价值的回答下面点赞和评论。
en: Search more for such content, and like and comment under valuable answers.

text: 然后回头再看一眼推荐，就会发现推荐的内容有所改变，这样可以利用算法推荐为你提供对你有效的内容
en: Then look back at recommendations, and you will find the recommended content has changed; this way you can use algorithmic recommendations to provide you with content that is effective for you.

text: 第三件事，多与朋友讨论一些问题，问问他们的看法，不同行业的人会对一些问题有不一样的观点，说不定让你耳目一新
en: The third thing is to discuss some issues with friends more, and ask their opinions. People from different industries will have different views on some issues, which may refresh you.

text: 第四件事，永远保持开放的状态，接纳不同的信息与观点，通过自己的知识体系进行分析，最好能够将这些分析思考的过程写下来，回头再翻看这些思考过程，说不定可以让自己温故而知新。
en: The fourth thing is to always stay open, accept different information and views, analyse them through your own knowledge system, and preferably write down the process of analysis and thinking. Looking back at these thinking processes later may let you review the old and learn the new.

text: 多看英文信息。
en: Read more English information.

text: 世界网路上的信息百分之五十五是英语；百分之一点四是汉语。
en: 55% of information on the world's internet is in English; 1.4% is in Chinese.

text: 波兰语在网路世界都比汉语通用。
en: Even Polish is more widely used on the internet than Chinese.

text: 不见得能读英语说英语的人就不活在信息茧房，但是假如你只会说中文读中文，你一定活在信息茧房，这个毋庸置疑。
en: It is not necessarily true that people who can read and speak English do not live in an information cocoon, but if you can only speak and read Chinese, you definitely live in an information cocoon — of that there is no doubt.

text: 顺便说个题外话，你还真别小看俄罗斯，俄罗斯虽然被西方国家搞成这副德行，俄语还是网路第三大语言。
en: By the way, do not underestimate Russia. Although Russia has been made into this state by Western countries, Russian is still the third largest language on the internet.

text: 而且俄罗斯文学与政治宣传一向对西方世界有强大的影响力。
en: Moreover, Russian literature and political propaganda have always had a powerful influence on the Western world.

text: 以前我在RT上看过俄罗斯记者说“东方大国是经济的巨人，政治的侏儒，而俄罗斯是经济的侏儒，政治的巨人”这个评价基本上没错。
en: I once saw a Russian journalist on RT say: 'The Eastern great power is an economic giant and a political dwarf, while Russia is an economic dwarf and a political giant.' This assessment is basically correct.

text: 办法自然是直白且粗陋的。
en: The method is naturally straightforward and crude.

text: 因为大道至简，你就给我直接退出。
en: Because the great way is simple: just log out directly.

text: 就拿知乎来说，作为这两年的重度用户，为了不让自己深陷信息糖果的漩涡。
en: Take Zhihu, for example. As a heavy user these past two years, in order not to sink deep into the vortex of information candy.

text: 我刷知乎的时候，都是未登录状态。
en: When I browse Zhihu, I am always logged out.

text: 我直接退出账号，我就是个游客。
en: I log out of my account directly; I am just a visitor.

text: 所以，在情感类话题上，我既可以看到男人的想法，我也可以看到女性的想法；
en: So, on emotional topics, I can see both men's thoughts and women's thoughts;

text: 在政治上，我既可以看到左，也可以看到右，还可以看到绝大多数不明就里的纯扯蛋；
en: On politics, I can see the left, the right, and also the vast majority who have no idea what is going on and are just talking nonsense;

text: 在时事上，我既可以看到冷静的分析，也可以看到幼稚的自以为是，更多的是绝望的抖机灵；
en: On current affairs, I can see calm analysis, naive self-righteousness, and even more hopeless attempts at wit;

text: 在文化上，我既可以看到专注于某个领域的痴人，也可以看到招摇撞骗的竖子，更多的是学艺三分却自诩专家的自信之人；
en: On culture, I can see obsessives focused on a particular field, swindling scoundrels, and even more people who learned a third of a skill yet call themselves experts with confidence;

text: 科教文卫，地域差异，民族认同，历史探究等诸多领域，差不多什么都能见识一下。
en: In education, science, culture, health, regional differences, national identity, historical inquiry and many other fields, I can see roughly everything.

text: 这就很好，你甚至可以看到千篇一律的知乎体小说居然也有不那么千篇一律的家伙在坚持写着无人问津的文字。
en: This is very good. You can even see that among the cookie-cutter Zhihu-style novels, there are some not-so-cookie-cutter people persisting in writing words no one reads.

text: 甚至，你还能找到严肃文学的影子…
en: You can even find traces of serious literature…

text: 抖音亦然，因为我只有这两款社交软件，所以分享也就局限于此。
en: Douyin is the same. Because I only have these two social apps, my sharing is limited to them.

text: 抖音你只要是游客，你看到的海量低质量视频，会大大缩减你使用它的时间，这是哥秘不示人的绝招。
en: On Douyin, as long as you are a visitor, the massive low-quality videos you see will greatly reduce the time you spend using it. This is my secret trick that I do not share.

text: 人的意志力是有上限的，人抵抗诱惑的能力着实差到一言难尽，这都是真实存在的客观现实。
en: Human willpower has an upper limit, and human ability to resist temptation is truly too poor to describe — these are real, objective facts.

text: 所以，本质上，如果你一直以一个登录的状态去刷抖音，那么你看到的，一定是迎合你喜好的玩意，无穷无尽。
en: So, essentially, if you keep scrolling Douyin while logged in, what you see must be things catering to your preferences, endless.

text: 然而信息茧房的本质，是明为迎合，实则控制。
en: However, the essence of the information cocoon is that it appears to cater, but actually controls.

text: 它是要控制你的，禁锢你思想的发育，压缩你思考的时间。
en: It wants to control you, imprison the development of your thought, and compress the time you spend thinking.

text: 只要开心，只要爽，你不停地接受着一个虚拟的爽世界，最终就变成了一个现实生活安分守己且毫无生气的人。
en: As long as you are happy, as long as you feel good, you keep accepting a virtual world of pleasure, and eventually become a person who is well-behaved and lifeless in real life.

text: 麻木不仁的面对生活，愚蠢迟钝的面对人生，然后把对生活的休养生息全部寄希望于手机。
en: Facing life numbly, facing life stupidly and slowly, and then pinning all your hopes for rest and recuperation in life on your phone.

text: 躺在那里，用手机里的海量信息来麻痹自己的感官，说白了吧，就是精神吸毒。
en: Lying there, using the massive information on your phone to numb your senses. To put it bluntly, it is spiritual drug use.

text: 日复一日看不到头，无穷尽也，绝望叩问，却不知叩问谁…
en: Day after day with no end in sight, endless, hopeless questioning, yet not knowing whom to question…

text: 这就是精神被禁锢的底层逻辑，这才是现代人最真实的悲哀与不幸。
en: This is the underlying logic of the spirit being imprisoned, and this is the truest sorrow and misfortune of modern people.

text: 所以，当你能认识到这个问题的时候，你就要知道了，什么才是我们来人间一回的目的。
en: So, when you can recognise this problem, you should know what the purpose of our one trip to this human world is.

text: 是为了体验吗？
en: Is it for experience?

text: 是，但不全是。
en: Yes, but not entirely.

text: 我们体验只是肤浅的身体肌肤，感官器官综合起来的肤浅体会，你看到的，你听到的，你摸到的，你走过的，都是一种基于身体本能感知感受到的表象。
en: Our experience is only the superficial experience of the body's skin and sensory organs combined. What you see, hear, touch and walk past are all appearances perceived based on the body's instinctive perception.

text: 我们的体验之后，应是尽可能的触碰这个人间真实的内在。
en: After our experience, we should try as much as possible to touch the true inner nature of this human world.

text: 你想触碰的前提，就是你接触到的信息是真实的，可靠的，不带有任何主观色彩的。
en: The prerequisite for you to touch it is that the information you come into contact with is real, reliable, and without any subjective colouring.

text: 所以，触碰才是真实的体验，才是升华，才是无比真实的快乐。
en: So, touching is real experience, sublimation, and incomparably real happiness.

text: 你比如大腚。
en: Take big butts, for example.

text: 大腚的观感是极佳的，触感是柔软的，但是如果你只是在手机看一个又一个大腚，那抖音自然是明白你的底色，大腚喜好者。
en: A big butt looks excellent and feels soft, but if you only watch one big butt after another on your phone, Douyin will naturally understand your true nature: a big-butt lover.

text: 所以它的算法就给你一直推五湖四海的大腚，你看过一个大腚过后兴致盎然，你看过十个大腚以后眼光开始挑剔，觉得某些大腚并不符合审美，过于大腚，甚至是虚假的大腚，你都能看见臀垫。
en: So its algorithm keeps pushing you big butts from all over the world. After watching one big butt you are in high spirits; after watching ten big butts your taste starts to become picky, feeling that some big butts do not meet aesthetic standards, are too big-butt, or even fake big butts — you can even see the butt pads.

text: 当你赏析过百个大腚以后，一个小时就过去了，然而，你并没有过瘾，你没有心满意足，你反而更加焦虑，口渴，不得尽兴。
en: After appreciating a hundred big butts, an hour has passed. Yet you are not satisfied, you are not content; instead you are more anxious, thirsty, and not fully satisfied.

text: 于是你产生了一个不自知的潜意识，只要看更多的大腚，你一定会有心满意足的时刻。
en: Then you develop an unconscious subconscious: as long as you watch more big butts, you will definitely have a satisfying moment.

text: 错了，兄弟，真的错了。
en: Wrong, brother, really wrong.

text: 你即便花一天的时间看了天南地北上千个大腚，你依然不会满足，你只会疲累，直到累得眼眶雀青，手指僵化，动一下翻个身都费劲的时候，你才会恋恋不舍的放下手机。
en: Even if you spend a whole day watching thousands of big butts from all over the country, you still will not be satisfied; you will only be tired, until your eye sockets are dark, your fingers stiff, and even turning over in bed takes effort — only then will you reluctantly put down your phone.

text: 这个时候，抖音得到了日活人数，大腚们得到了关注流量，你，得到了什么？
en: At this point, Douyin has gained daily active users, the big butts have gained attention and traffic, and you — what have you gained?

text: 所以，正确的做法是什么？
en: So, what is the correct approach?

text: 你再也不看大腚？
en: Never watch big butts again?

text: 不对，你可以看，但是你不能只在网上看，你要走出去看现实的大腚，继而想办法触碰真实的大腚，继而实现对大腚这一执念的完美闭环，这就是触碰人间真实的意义。
en: No: you can watch, but you cannot only watch online. You must go out and see real big butts, and then find a way to touch real big butts, thereby achieving a perfect closed loop of this obsession with big butts. This is the meaning of touching the reality of the human world.

text: 这才是真的来过人间。
en: This is what it means to have truly been in this world.

text: 你看过，不算来过。
en: Having seen it does not count as having been here.

text: 哥，只是举了一个最浅薄的例子，方便读者理解。
en: I am just giving the most shallow example, to make it easier for readers to understand.

text: 要么说关注哥的兄弟们年龄跨度那么大呢…
en: No wonder the brothers who follow me span such a wide age range…

text: 十几岁的也有，八九十岁的老叔也有…
en: There are teenagers, and there are old uncles in their eighties and nineties…

text: 棍哥的文字，老少咸宜。
en: Gun Ge's writing suits all ages.

text: 信息过载着实是没必要的，你没有必要关注那么多的博主，你关注那么几十个真有料的就行，比如棍哥这样的。
en: Information overload is really unnecessary. You do not need to follow so many bloggers; just follow a few dozen who truly have substance, like Gun Ge here.

text: 就这样吧，你们可以试试棍哥的方法，先试试抖音，当你是一个都市白领，你的抖音却开始给你推送上一个养鸭子如何赶鸭，下一个广场舞劲爆金曲，再下一个是手搓缝纫机，再再下一个是佛光普照，刷到的都是有缘人的时候…
en: That is all. You can try Gun Ge's method: first try Douyin. When you are an urban white-collar worker, but your Douyin starts pushing you, one after another, how to herd ducks as a duck farmer, then explosive square-dance hits, then hand-sewing machines, then Buddha's light shining everywhere, and all you scroll to are people with fate…

text: 你最多刷十分钟你就会感到无趣了，你就有时间去感受真实的世界了，或许你会在百无聊赖的时候开始尝试真实的社交，深度的阅读，完整的学习，酣畅淋漓的锻炼，甚至是做一顿饭，完整的看一部电影，不管什么吧，都比沉浸在信息糖果漩涡中无法自拔要强百倍。
en: You will feel bored after at most ten minutes, and then you will have time to feel the real world. Perhaps in your boredom you will start trying real socialising, deep reading, complete learning, hearty exercise, or even cooking a meal, or watching a complete film. No matter what, it is a hundred times better than being unable to extricate yourself from the vortex of information candy.

text: 祝兄弟们都能拥有属于自己的人生大腚。
en: May all you brothers have your own life's big butt.

text: 此腚非彼腚，不要肤浅了啊~
en: This butt is not that butt — don't be superficial~
